description: Creates, changes, completes, or deletes a reminder, or creates or deletes a list. action: create (title; notes, list, due, priority, url, repeat optional), update (id and only the fields to change), complete or uncomplete (id), delete (id; its subtasks go with it; it can't be undone), create_list (title), delete_list (list and reminder_count: how many reminders it holds, open and completed, as reminders_find with list says; the list and all its reminders are deleted and can't be brought back). due is a day (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the Mac's time zone (optionally with Z or ±HH:MM)); with a time, the Mac alerts then. An empty text clears a field. Flags, tags, subtasks, and sections are shown but can't be changed: that needs the Reminders app's window, which Latchkey doesn't use.

list.description: The list (name or id; default the Mac's default list)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

reminder_count.description: For delete_list: how many reminders the list holds, open and completed

repeat.description: How it repeats; none stops repeating

repeat_count.description: Or: how many times in all

repeat_every.description: Repeat every this many days, weeks, … (default 1)

title.description: The reminder's or new list's title

name: reminders_change
title: Change Reminders
